validation.title: Validation
validation.body: Where ITZA's methods were checked against public records and research.

validation.history.title: Inferred history vs. public crop records
validation.history.intro: Field Memory's label next to the public record, season by season. Every result is shown.

validation.akron.title: Rotation ranking vs. a published long-term trial
validation.akron.intro: ITZA's ranking of two rotations the trial also compared, next to the trial's result.
validation.akron.productRanking: ITZA ranks {favored} higher (median {favoredScore} vs. {otherScore}) on criteria the trial did not measure: stress, soil health, erosion, pests and margin.
validation.akron.directional: Directional only: the trial measured yield and income on research plots; ITZA scores stress and soil-health proxies nearby. Only the ranking's direction is compared.
validation.akron.error: Could not run the replay for this comparison.
validation.transfer.title: What this does, and does not, prove
validation.transfer.body: Where public records exist, as here, ITZA's methods are checked against them. On a farmer's own field, the farmer's confirmed seasons replace that check, and local review stays necessary.
validation.loadError: The proof fields could not be loaded. Open one from the Demo fields list once while online, then try again.
validation.sources.body: Three sampling areas near Akron, Colorado, have public crop records for 2008–2023. Field Memory never sees them.
validation.sources.caveat: The record is a satellite crop map (USDA CDL), not a farmer's log, and outlines are sampling areas. Some disagreement comes from the record itself.
validation.history.reason: Most misses are fallow seasons read as crop: the 250 m pixel can catch weeds or a neighbouring field.
validation.provenance.fieldMemory.source: NASA MODIS vegetation index (MOD13Q1), read by Field Memory
validation.provenance.cdl.source: USDA Cropland Data Layer (public crop record)
validation.akron.summary: {agree} of {total} proof fields rank the trial's better rotation higher
validation.akron.disagreeReason: Likely because ITZA scores stress, soil and erosion, not income, and a sampling area is not a research plot.
